mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consult_session (id, scenario_code, status, current_step, answers, report, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{scenarioCode}, #{status}, #{currentStep}, #{answers}, #{report}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE consult_session SET status = #{status}, current_step = #{currentStep}, answers = #{answers}, report = #{report}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE consult_session SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM consult_session WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM consult_session WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY update_time DESC
